subject: Trading
title: What Is Risk?
description: A quick, practical guide to What Is Risk?.

hook.text: Most people think risk means losing money. In trading, risk is the uncertainty of outcomes—up or down.

buildup.text: Risk isn't just about loss. It's the probability-weighted range of possible results from any trade or investment.

discovery.text: Volatility—how much prices swing—is the most common measure of risk. Higher swings mean more uncertainty.

twist.text: Low-volatility stocks aren't always 'safe.' They can gap down overnight on bad news, devastating holders.

climax.text: Risk can be measured, managed, and reduced—but never eliminated. Accepting that is where trading maturity begins.

punchline.text: Risk isn't the enemy. Unmanaged risk is.

quiz.question: What does risk mean in trading?
options: The uncertainty of outcomes including both gains and losses
